Method of Attack: Poisoning deep learning-based AI algorithms by inserting backdoor-like malicious triggers in AI training models
Embedding triggers in AI models to misinterpret inputs (e.g., misinterpreting Stop signs with stickers)
Poisoning training sets to maintain or increase attack efficiency
Insertion of malicious code via compromised cloud service accounts using social engineering (phishing)
Open-sourcing backdoored AI models hoping for reuse without detection
Discoverer: Three researchers from New York University (NYU)
Impacted Systems: AI systems trained via Machine-Learning-as-a-Service (MLaaS) platforms such as Google Cloud Machine Learning Engine, Microsoft Azure Batch AI Training, Amazon EC2
Attack Vector: Compromise of cloud service accounts via social engineering (phishing)
Reuse of open-sourced backdoored AI models
